recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the accepted SHOULD guidance, avoids strengthening the base requirement, and removes stale pre-FHIR-41589 wording from active ValueSet build inputs.
issue_request: FHIR-41589 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 vocab Change Request asking the $expand documentation to clarify that ValueSet.expansion.parameter entries in the returned ValueSet are not necessarily only the input parameters supplied by the client.
initial_application: Commit 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98 applied the accepted narrative list to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml. The active ValueSet/$expand return parameter documentation and the ValueSet.expansion.parameter element comment still used the older broad wording, so the issue was only partially applied.
additional_context: Terminology Infrastructure WGM minutes for 2023-09-13 record that FHIR-41639 handled the terminology-artifact accounting portion and that FHIR-41589 should keep SHOULD rather than SHALL because the base specification should not require expansion parameters by default. FHIR-41639 later documented the used-system, used-supplement, and used-valueset response parameters, which are the specific artifact-accounting parameters relevant to FHIR-41589.
reconciliation: Updated source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml so the active generated operation page and element definition now say expansion parameters SHOULD record used input parameters, defaulted input parameter values, and CodeSystems, CodeSystem Supplements, and ValueSets used in the expansion, with links to the ValueSet Expansion Parameters narrative.
source_changes: source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml: updated the $expand return output parameter documentation to reference the accepted expansion parameter categories and the narrative section.
source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml: updated the ValueSet.expansion.parameter comment to mirror the accepted categories while preserving the persisted-expansion SHALL guidance.

related_jiras.note: Documented used-system, used-supplement, and used-valueset as the terminology-artifact accounting parameters referenced by FHIR-41589 and the WGM minutes.
